title: Book Three · Chapter 153: The Winter Evening
story:
On Monday, Ronan writes his twenty-first letter to Leo.

The winter holiday has begun. His three paid Saturdays are finished. He starts with the cupboard and the man beside the measuring table.

Then he tells Leo about Anna's visit. He has not seen the model room himself. He describes the roof from her drawing and says whose story it is.

She went with her mother, he writes. I wanted to go too. I kept the work mornings. She has questions about the drawings now, and I have questions about practical classes.

He finishes with one question about Leo's holiday. Then he signs and folds the page.

His birthday book is open beside him. Leo's address paper is still with the class photo. He copies the address onto the envelope, then puts the book away.

After lunch, Ronan takes the envelope to the post office. He pays the stamp from his separate spending money and posts the letter.

His work envelope stays at home with twenty-seven yuan. The old book-sale share is still separate. He has paid no course fee.

That evening, Mum sits on her dark cushion with a book. Dad is putting the clean bowls away.

He begins to hum the tune from their walk in the square. Ronan recognises the first part. The second still goes another way.

Mum lifts her eyes from the page.

“You kept that song.”

“Both songs,” Dad says.

Ronan laughs. Dad sets the last bowl down and tries the second part again.

Mum puts a finger between her pages. She hums the right notes softly.

Dad listens, then follows her. This time, the last two notes are right.

“There,” she says.

“Again?”

She closes the book and starts from the beginning. Ronan takes the chair near the table and joins the part he knows.

Outside, Mr Qiu is closing his stall. He stops beyond the kitchen window for a moment.

“A new song?” he asks.

“Two old ones,” Ronan says.

Dad laughs and loses the next note. Mum shakes her head, but she is smiling too.

Mr Qiu lifts his hand and goes back to his boxes. The three finish the tune at their own quiet pace.

Afterward, Mum opens her book again. Dad takes his cup to the chair beside her. Ronan finds his own school pages and lays them near the light.

He reads the first question while Dad hums the correct ending once more. Mum taps two fingers against the arm of her chair, and Ronan moves his pencil gently in time before he writes his answer.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

recognise＝认出、听出；hum＝哼唱；tune＝曲调；in time＝合着拍子。

## 理解问题

1. 第二十一封信已经实际寄出吗？工资与旧书款有没有混用或新增课程支出？
2. 家庭晚间的快乐来自什么？父母是否只在处理Ronan的工作与恋爱？

## 读句子

**The three finish the tune at their own quiet pace.**

拆开看：The three / finish the tune / at their own quiet pace.

一家三人／唱完这段曲调／按他们自己轻缓的节奏。
